snippet.title: Plants on Fire is Growing! Join the New Adventure Now!
snippet.description:
Hi Captains! 
Welcome to the Plants on Fire World! A huge thank you to our existing players for your continued support, and a warm welcome to all the new Captains joining! Now the adventure is growing — get ready to explore, battle, and build your team!Let's grow stronger together and make this journey unforgettable!
